svg.title: How a Voice Support turn is governed
svg.desc: A customer request moves through intake and transcript confirmation, model interpretation, and Support State Core. The deterministic core selects guide, troubleshoot, or mock handoff. Audit and evaluation happen after the response and do not change the live decision.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: How a support turn is governed

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The model proposes. Trusted state and fixed policy decide. The customer remains the actor.

text.tspan: Local decision trace remains primary. Configured model judges review after the response.
Evaluation can inform a reviewed change; it never changes the live lane.
